reason: I already paid one agency that sent a lot of activity reports and no real deals. EUR 6,500 locked in for three months, and you won't even promise one meeting. With my money that's too big a bet on something I don't believe works with my buyers.
objection: Cold email does not work in our industry. My buyers are relationship people who buy from someone they met at a fair or were introduced to, and here I pay the full three months before I know whether it does anything.
would_change_my_mind: Pay per qualified meeting, or a one-month paid pilot with no minimum, plus two or three references from SaaS or IT services companies selling into DACH that I can call myself.
